column1: # Phrases a guided Krok po kroku lesson teaches in its vocabulary list
# (data/src/androidMain/assets/lesson_<id>.json) that the corpus did not carry yet.
# The file name keeps this list after every other topic file. Ids are handed out in
# load order, so appending here never renumbers a word a lesson, preset or stored
# favourite already points at; a new word for a later lesson goes at the end.
# Glosses follow the lesson's own vocabulary table. Where the corpus already has the
# same English for a different phrase, the gloss says what sets this one apart.
